description: SeleneNav Dynamics is building ArtemisPath: an open-source 3D WebGIS tool solving the low-elevation shadow vs Direct-To-Earth communications trade-study for NASA CLPS lunar south pole landings. We are orbital modelers, software engineers, and GIS developers looking for collaborators passionate about WebGL/CesiumJS, astrodynamics, and high-impact UI/UX. Join us to help commercial and Artemis missions land safely!

details: AgriTerra Analytics is developing FieldShift AI: a climate-adaptation decision engine translating NASA SMAP and POWER Earth observations into resilient multi-year crop rotations. We empower smallholder farmers facing drought and soil degradation with accessible web & SMS guidance. We welcome agronomists, Python/FastAPI developers, and UI designers eager to apply space data to global food security!
